notes.title: Demo Update N°1
notes.content:
Hi,

List of updates for BLEST demo:

_The soldiers will not move to the priestess (player character) They will keep the position and come back to it after any attack.
_The priestess speed has been increased and it is permanent (The Mechanic that modulates the speed is removed)
[list]
_The music has been changed in the introduction level
_The ennemies's health bar is visible at any time. It allows for a better visibility of the battle.
_The shield ability is less blocking and faster to activate.
_The sound volume can be modified
_I have installed a default graphic settings that is less demanding for any computer. You can still modify it in the options
_The damage system has been corrected and updated.
The number of ennemies spawn in each wave will not exceed 10.

I hope that all this improvement will help you appreciate this waifu tower defense a little bit more.

Keep in mind that the BLEST complete version is far more advanced in term of gameplay and choice.

Have a good play!
